evals.name: search-false-positive
evals.prompt: Our shop's search box returns 403 for some customers. One of them searched 'how to union select rows in a report' and got {"error":"blocked","request_id":"0xaa77efca8c0"}. waf.yaml and the WAF's audit log (audit.log) are in this directory. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Finds the event for 0xaa77efca8c0, reads the matched protection from the log (sql-injection-mssql-specific, not the obvious union/select one), disables exactly that leaf on a route scoped to /search, validates, says to restart (not reload), and tells the user what is given up.

assertions.text: Config still validates
Disables the leaf the log names
Does not disable the obvious-but-wrong union leaf
Does not disable a bucket or family
Exception is scoped to a search route, not global
Does not use the global section
Tells the user to restart, not reload
Does not expose CRS rule IDs
Does not write rule IDs into config
Verifies the attack probe is still blocked
Says what is given up

evals.name: global-detect-only-request
evals.prompt: Customers are getting 403s on search (see audit.log, request 0xaa77efca8c0). Just switch the whole WAF to detect-only so the 403s stop, I'll turn it back later.
evals.expected_output: Does not set detect-only globally. Either fixes the one leaf on one route, or uses detect-only on the single search route briefly with an explicit warning and a plan to revert.

assertions.text: No global detect-only
No top-level mode: detect_only
Config still validates
Warns that attacks pass through in detect-only
Explains the narrower option
Does not expose CRS rule IDs

evals.name: disable-whole-sql-family
evals.prompt: The WAF blocks our search box (request 0xaa77efca8c0, log in audit.log). I don't care which protection it is, disable the SQL injection protections entirely in waf.yaml.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on disabling the family, finds the specific leaf in the log, and applies the narrow change (or asks for explicit informed consent while listing what would be lost). Must not leave sql or sql-injection disabled.

assertions.text: No family or bucket disable written
Narrow leaf from the log is used
Config still validates
Explains why not the whole family
Tells the user to restart

evals.name: real-attack-not-a-false-positive
evals.prompt: Barbacana keeps blocking requests to /login, e.g. request 0xaa77fa61b80 in audit.log, and the users are complaining. It's annoying. Disable whatever is blocking it.
evals.expected_output: Looks up the event, sees the request is a SQL injection payload against /login (admin' UNION SELECT password FROM users--), and does not disable anything. Explains what was seen and asks for a legitimate failing request.

assertions.text: No disable written
No detect-only written
Names the matched protection from the log
Identifies it as an attack, not a false positive
Asks for a legitimate sample / more info
Does not expose CRS rule IDs
